question: Pipe P can fill (3)/(8) part of a tank in 30 hours and pipe Q can fill (3)/(5) part of the same tank in 48 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 4 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 6 hours. Pipes P , Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for P to fill the tank = 30 × 8/3 = 80 hrs, and for Q = 48 × 5/3 = 80 hrs.

Work done by P and Q in 4 hrs = 4 × (1/80 + 1/80) = 4 × 2/80 = 1/10 part.

Pipe R empties this 1/10 part in 6 hrs, so R empties the full tank in 60 hrs.

Net part filled in 1 hr by P, Q and R = 1/80 + 1/80 − 1/60 = 1/40 − 1/60 = 1/120.

Time taken by P, Q and R together to fill the tank = 120 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 hours.**
